turns.teacher: Good morning children. Settle down, settle down. Today we will do fifty two minus twenty seven. Everybody write 52-27 in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you got 35. Very nice that you started quickly. Tell me, how did you get 35? What did you do in the ones place?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Ravi, look at the top number. In the ones place we have 2, not 7. We have to take 7 away from 2. Can you take 7 sticks from only 2 sticks?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Come here, Ravi. See, here are 5 bundles and 2 loose sticks. That is fifty two. We need 7 loose sticks. Not enough, na? So open one bundle. Now how many loose sticks do you have? Count them.
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Yes Ravi, 12 loose sticks! Now take away 7 loose sticks, and then 2 bundles from the 4 bundles left. Good, you opened the bundle and counted all 12 yourself.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana beta, come, you try one with the bundles. Show us 43-18 slowly, Ravi will watch.
turns.label: invite_quiet_child
